p1: He pulled over beside a forest... and took out a revolver and a rope.
Every backpacker knows the warning: never get in a stranger's car. In Australia, it came true.
January 1990. British backpacker Paul Onions hitchhikes south of Sydney.
A man calling himself Bill offers him a lift.
Near Belanglo State Forest, he pulls over. Out comes the gun.
Paul runs onto the highway. Bill fires at him.
A passing driver gets him to the police.
Nobody follows it up... for four years.
1992. Runners in that forest find a body.
In the end, seven backpackers are found there.
Paul calls from England. In 1994, he identifies Bill.
Seven life sentences. He died in prison, and never confessed.
Paul is the man who got out of that car.
